       object_type as target,
       status as status,

          2

    start_time                              AS restore_date,
    operation                               AS scenario,
    object_type                             AS target,
    status                                  AS status,
    ROUND(elapsed_seconds / 60, 2)          AS estimated_time_min

WHERE
    operation IN (
        'RESTORE',
        'RECOVER',
        'RECOVER DATABASE',
        'RECOVER TABLE'
    )
ORDER BY
    start_time DESC
